item.text: The repository confirms that each ID currently stores an opaque `maphash.Seed`, so callers cannot set or restore one. I’ll store caller supplied seed strings, keep one hash seed on each `Hasher`, and protect the seed map because database connections can call the hash function concurrently.

The seed API is in place, and the hasher tests pass. The new cases cover explicit seeds, reseeding, restoring a prior seed, package level `SetSeed`, and automatic initialization. I’ll check formatting and run the local tests for the database callers next.

item.text:
Added exported `Hasher` and package and method `SetSeed` APIs. An ID now keeps its assigned seed, so changing it changes the hash and restoring it restores the original hash. IDs without a seed are initialized automatically.

Hasher, race, database, and persistence tests pass. Hashes are reproducible within a `Hasher` instance; the `maphash` seed is process local, so identical results across restarts are not guaranteed.
